home.photoBar: CENSORED · FOR WHAT LITTLE DIGNITY REMAINS
home.photoText1: This is the moment Tanh opened the banking app on the 26th. The photo is 100% real. Those eyes once believed in the future.
home.photoText2: Now they only believe in instant noodles.
home.victimAlt: Photo of the victim, partly censored
letter: To the stranger reading these lines,
I do not know who you are. Perhaps you are in bed, scrolling on your phone, with a full stomach. I am glad for you. Truly.
As for me, I just stood in front of the fridge for the fourth time tonight. Every time I open it there is one egg and a bottle of chilli sauce that expired back when I still believed in love.
I am not asking for much. Just one meal with meat in it, ordered without checking the price column first.
If you do not help, I will not blame you. I will quietly eat the last packet of noodles, and think about you.
home.diaryTitle1: My salary passes through my life

diary.text: Payday. I smiled. I ordered bubble tea with every topping. I thought I was rich.
Paid the rent, the electricity, and last month's debt to myself.
Started cooking at home. Bought 30 packets of noodles “just in case”.
Ate the noodles without the oil sachet. Saving it.
Used the oil sachet from day 15. Felt like a man who plans ahead.
One packet of noodles left, one egg, and you.

faq.question: Where does the money go?
faq.answer: Into a stomach. 100%. The financial report is a photo of a dinner tray.

faq.question: Is this a scam?
faq.answer: No. This is begging in the open: transparent and shameless. You know exactly who you are feeding.

faq.question: Is the fund licensed?
faq.answer: No. But there is a driving licence, if that makes you feel better.

faq.question: Are refunds available?
faq.answer: No. But there is a sincere thank you, possibly with a sticker.
